name: Positive Energy Resistance [General]
body:
You have adapted to become resilient to positive energy damage.

Prerequisites: Undead type

Benefit: You gain positive energy resistance equal to 5 + your Hit Dice.

Special: This feat may be retrained at no cost if you cease being undead. It still takes time to retrain.
